## Data flow

- Owner/MT5 history -> MTF_DATA: Native M5/M15/H1/H4 inputs are resolved to one broker symbol and causally normalized.
- MTF_DATA -> RESEARCH: Validated datasets, alignment and lineage feed strategy/model research.
- STRATEGY_OPT -> GOVERNANCE: Eligible optimizer winner is registered as Strategy Challenger, never auto-promoted.
- RESEARCH + MODELS -> FACTORY: Candidate evidence progresses through deterministic lifecycle gates.
- FACTORY -> GOVERNANCE: Qualified Factory winner is registered as Model Challenger before any Champion promotion.
- SCIENTIST -> RESEARCH/FACTORY: Advisory proposals are admitted only through deterministic legality/capacity/scientific checks.
- GOVERNANCE -> EA_RUNTIME: Only explicit accepted release/Champion authority may change production deployment identity.
- ACCEPTANCE -> project state: Executed evidence constrains what may be claimed as PASS.

## External boundaries

- MetaTrader 5 / Strategy Tester: External execution/data authority; required Owner evidence for production closure.
- MetaEditor: External compile authority; semantic log + fresh EX5 + provenance, not return code alone.
- NVIDIA/CUDA: External accelerator capability; no silent CPU equivalence when CUDA proof is required.
- LLM providers: Advisory Scientist dependency; provider failure cannot override deterministic Factory authority.
- Browser/Streamlit: Rendered UI behavior requires runtime/browser acceptance where required.
